method: KEYFRAME-FIRST: refs, then a free Nano Banana still per beat, then Frames to Video on Veo 3.1 Lite from each still. Motion + sound prompts only.
cast: four friends, late 20s, two men and two women
setting_basis: A small city flat in the afternoon, then the tidal flats of Chandipur on the Odisha coast at low tide in the same late-afternoon light: a vast, almost perfectly flat expanse of wet grey-brown sand with fine ripples and shallow pools, a low line of casuarina trees at the back of the beach, the sea only a thin bright line far out. No resort, no shacks, no palm-fringed Goa beach. Goa is only talked about and never shown, and the footage makes no distance, crowd or tide-time claim of its own.
look: Soft natural light, natural colour, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, photorealistic, cinematic. Faces are never in close-up and no one looks at the camera. A phone screen is only a soft glow, never legible. No other people. No music, no speech, no voiceover, no text, captions, logos or watermark.

refs.name: ref_friends
refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of four Indian friends in their late twenties standing in a loose row: a tall man with a short side-parted haircut in a navy polo shirt and grey chinos; a stocky man with long hair tied back in a maroon t-shirt and cargo shorts; a woman with a long single braid in a white cotton shirt and rolled olive trousers; a woman with a shoulder-length bob in a yellow sleeveless top and blue jeans; all in sandals, standing indoors in soft afternoon window light, three-quarter view, neutral expressions, photorealistic, no text.

refs.name: ref_seabed
refs.prompt: A vast, almost perfectly flat tidal beach at low tide on the Odisha coast in late-afternoon light: wet grey-brown sand with fine ripples and shallow pools stretching far out, the sea only a thin bright line at the horizon, a low line of casuarina trees at the back of the beach, no buildings, no shacks, no people, photorealistic, no text.

keyframes.name: kf_s1
keyframes.prompt: Extreme wide shot at low tide in late-afternoon light: bare wet seabed stretching far out to a thin bright line of sea at the horizon, ripples and small pools catching the light, casuarina trees small at the edge of frame, no people.

keyframes.name: kf_s2
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot from behind in a small flat's living room in soft late-afternoon window light: the four friends sit on a sofa and on the floor around one open laptop, its screen turned away from camera.

keyframes.name: kf_s3
keyframes.prompt: Medium shot from the side in the same flat and light: the man in the navy polo holds his phone out toward the others, its screen only a soft glow, while the woman with the long braid beside him has stopped typing on the laptop; faces turned away from camera.

keyframes.name: kf_s4
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot from behind in late-afternoon light: the four friends walk slowly side by side across the empty wet seabed toward the far thin line of sea, small in the frame, their reflections in the wet sand.

keyframes.name: kf_s5
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot from behind in late-afternoon light: the woman with the long braid stands alone and still on the exposed wet seabed, wind moving her braid and white shirt, the other three small and far behind her.

keyframes.name: kf_s6
keyframes.prompt: Extreme wide shot in late-afternoon light: the four friends stand small and far out on the empty wet seabed, the woman with the long braid furthest ahead, the sea a thin bright line beyond them, nobody else anywhere in frame.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still as the late light shimmers on the wet sand and a thin film of water slides across the ripples.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. He holds the phone out a little further and her hands stop above the keyboard.
shots.sound: A ceiling fan turning, a laptop fan whirring, a quiet room.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still as the four walk slowly side by side across the wet sand, all four staying in frame.
shots.sound: Bare feet on wet sand, wind across the flats, distant surf.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. The wind moves her braid and shirt as she stands quite still, looking out at the thin line of the sea.
shots.sound: Only wind across the open flats, very faint surf.

shots.prompt: A slow push in as the late light glints on the wet sand around the four of them.
shots.sound: Wind, a far-off gull, the distant hiss of the sea.

en: There's a beach where the sea walks away, and four of us nearly picked Goa.
Ira wanted a party, so Goa was half booked when Kabir said wait.
He'd found one on NakshIQ where you walk up to five kilometres of seabed.
Goa would be packed, it said, and out there you might be alone.

That meant no shacks, no party, so Ira nearly said no.
Then she stood where the sea had been, heard only wind, and went quiet.

She walked out furthest, and for an hour Odisha's Chandipur felt like ours.
Travel intelligence is knowing what you give up, and going anyway.
NakshIQ.
hi: एक बीच है जहाँ समंदर पीछे चला जाता है, और हम चारों लगभग गोवा चुन चुके थे।
इरा को पार्टी चाहिए थी, तो गोवा की आधी बुकिंग हो चुकी थी, तभी कबीर बोला रुको।
NakshIQ पर उसे ऐसा बीच मिला, जहाँ पानी उतरे तो पाँच किलोमीटर तक अंदर पैदल जा सकते हो।
लिखा था गोवा में भीड़ मिलेगी, और वहाँ शायद तुम अकेले होगे।

मतलब न शैक, न पार्टी, तो इरा ने लगभग मना ही कर दिया था।
फिर वो वहाँ खड़ी हुई जहाँ समंदर था, बस हवा की आवाज़ थी, और वो चुप हो गई।

सबसे दूर तक वही गई, और कुछ देर के लिए ओडिशा का चांदीपुर बस हमारा था।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस है, पता हो कि क्या छोड़ रहे हो, और फिर भी चल पड़ो।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: Goa, or the beach where|*the sea leaves?*
